name: Alucardo
history: Alucardo fue un grupo activo entre 2017 y 2018, de estilo death metal melódico con influencias de Sound of Silence, Tragic Vision, The Black Dahlia Murder, At the Gates, As Hope Dies y As Blood Runs Black.
historyEn: Alucardo was a band active between 2017 and 2018, of melodic death metal style with influences of Sound of Silence, Tragic Vision, The Black Dahlia Murder, At the Gates, As Hope Dies and As Blood Runs Black.
